provenance.source: SolidWorks 重算的躯干质量属性，再按实称的分段质量微调；躯干数字不是 SolidWorks 原样
provenance.note: units as printed by SolidWorks: mass kg, CoM mm, inertia kg*mm^2
provenance.assumption: 坐标系1 is coincident with the MJCF trunk_base BODY frame
conventions_verified_on_this_report: Off-diagonals are PRODUCTS of inertia (SW 'positive tensor notation'); MuJoCo fullinertia wants the inertia MATRIX entries = the negated values. Proof on THIS report: negating them makes the report's own principal rows eigenvectors of the tensor with the printed moments as eigenvalues -- I@(0.587,0,0.810)=(57.052,-0.010,78.721) vs Px*(0.587,0,0.810)=(57.050,0,78.723), and eigenvalues match (97.188,153.431,161.757) vs printed (97.189,153.431,161.757) to 0.0005 kg*mm^2.

Parallel-axis between the two printed blocks holds: off-diagonal P_ij(com) = P_ij(origin) - m*c_i*c_j agrees to 0.002 kg*mm^2; diagonal I_ii(com) = I_ii(origin) - m*(c_j^2+c_k^2) agrees to 0.123 kg*mm^2, and that residual is fully explained by SW printing the mass to 3 decimals while using ~0.20019 kg internally (the two large diagonals both imply 0.20019).
